newsitem.title: JAPAN: East JR may issue mortgage bonds -- underwriters.
newsitem.headline: East JR may issue mortgage bonds -- underwriters.

text.p: East Japan Railway Co may issue general mortgage bonds worth 100 billion yen, underwriting sources said on Tuesday.
"The company is likely to issue 60 billion yen worth of bonds with a maturity of 12 years and 40 billion yen worth of bonds with a maturity of 20 years," one underwriter said.
Another underwriter said that Japan's largest railway company had already selected two major brokerages to lead manage the bonds.
However, a company source said that the company had not decided on any concrete details although it had been considering issuing straight bonds.
The company told the Ministry of Finance in July 1995 that it may issue 500 billion yen worth of bonds in the next two years. It has since issued 100 billion yen worth of bonds.
